patch: UPDATE tax_data SET field_value = '80000' WHERE field_name = 'w2_gross_wages' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2024 AND lower(status) = 'filed')

UPDATE tax_documents SET data_json = replace(replace(data_json, '"wages": "136320.0"', '"wages": "80000"'), '"wages": "136320"', '"wages": "80000"') WHERE lower(doc_type) LIKE '%w2%' AND return_id IN (SELECT id FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2024 AND lower(status) = 'filed')
